storyCards.headline: Just Like Heaven: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Cure's "Just Like Heaven" reached #40 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #40 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Galore: The Singles 1987-1997" (1997) — not the song's original release year.

Album: Galore: The Singles 1987-1997 (1997).
